info.title: FieldEquip API
info.description:
FieldEquip API Interface Specifications v2.11

This document describes the standard data fields for RESTful APIs that will be integrated with external systems. FE uses API key-based authentication while integrating with external systems. All the Create and Update requests support both single object and multiple objects in an array.

**General Rules:**
- `companyId` is mandatory for every API call. FieldEquip will provide the company ID.
- Fields with no data are omitted from the response (not sent as null or empty string).
- All DateTime fields use UTC format (e.g., 2020-08-21T07:38:44.293Z).
- All Date fields use ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2023-08-21).
- All Time fields use 24-hour format (e.g., 07:15, 17:15).

post.description:
Creates one or more work orders in the FieldEquip system.

The new version supports batch operation in which the payload can contain one or more work orders. Any custom fields defined in FE for a company on the work order can be added to the request by using the internal key while defining the custom field.

**Business Rules (generateWorkOrderId):**
- If `orderId` is not provided and `generateWorkOrderId` is `false` (default), the system will return an error (Invalid Request)
- If the provided `orderId` already exists in the system, the system will return an error (Duplicate Id)
- If `orderId` is provided and `generateWorkOrderId` is `false`, a work order will be created with the given orderId
- If `orderId` is provided and `generateWorkOrderId` is `true`, the system will return an error (Invalid Request)

**Field Service Categories (fieldServiceId):**
- 10 = Alarm
- 20 = Pumps
- 30 = Controls
- 40 = Motors
- 50 = Recycling

**Priority Values:**
- 10 = Low (Default)
- 20 = Medium
- 30 = High
- 40 = Critical

post.description:
Updates one or more work order details in the FieldEquip system.

This version supports batch operation in which the payload can contain one or more work orders.

**Business Rules:**
- The update operation will not remove the line items added during the work order creation. It will update or insert the new line items as per the payload but will not remove the line items added during the create operation which are missing in the update payload.
- The `sparse` field (default: true) is reserved for future use. If not supplied, it will be assumed true.

**Status Values:**
- 10 = Unassigned
- 20 = On Hold
- 30 = Working
- 40 = Completed
- 45 = Billing Approved
- 50 = Cleared
- 60 = Deleted
- 70 = Invoiced

**Priority Values:**
- 10 = Low (Default)
- 20 = Medium
- 30 = High
- 40 = Critical

get.description:
Retrieves work order details from the FieldEquip system.

The request should include one of these date fields: `updatedAfter`, `createdAfter`, or `completedAfter`.

**Date Parameter Rules:**
- `updatedAfter`: Returns all work orders updated after the given timestamp. The difference between this value and the current date/time cannot exceed 60 days.
- `createdAfter`: Returns all work orders created after the given timestamp. The difference between this value and the current date/time cannot exceed 60 days.
- `completedAfter`: Returns all work orders completed after the given timestamp. The difference between this value and the current date/time cannot exceed 60 days.

**Filtering Priority:**
- If `orderId` or `sourceKey` is provided, the date fields (`updatedAfter`, `createdAfter`, `completedAfter`) will be ignored.

**Status Values:**
- 10 = Unassigned
- 20 = On Hold
- 30 = Working
- 40 = Completed
- 45 = Billing Approved
- 50 = Cleared
- 60 = Deleted
- 70 = Invoiced

**Priority Values:**
- 10 = Low (Default)
- 20 = Medium
- 30 = High
- 40 = Critical

**sourceSys Values:**
- F = FieldEquip (reserved for future expansion)

get.description:
Retrieves field ticket details from the FieldEquip system.

The API returns a collection of Field Tickets with their associated line items.

**Query Parameter Rules:**
- When `fieldTicketId` is provided, other filter parameters `dateApproved` and `status` will be ignored.
- `dateApproved`: Returns all tickets approved on the requested date, irrespective of the Field Ticket date.

**Field Ticket Status Values:**
- 10 = Completed
- 20 = Approved
- 30 = Billing Approved
- 40 = Invoiced
- 50 = Canceled

**Item Notes:**
- `itemName`, `itemDesc`, `itemQty`, `itemRate`, and `itemAmount` are skipped when `consolidated=true`.
- `resource` and `resourceId` are available only for Labor and Equipment item types. For Labor, `resourceId` will be the employee ID.

get.description:
Retrieves approved labor hours from the FieldEquip system.

The API returns a collection of employee details with their work hour records.

**Query Parameter Rules:**
- `dateFrom`: Returns all approved records where the `transactionDate` equals the requested date.
- `dateApproved`: Returns all approved records where the `approvedOn` date equals the requested date, irrespective of the `transactionDate`.
- Both parameters can be combined, and the system will return matching records.

Retrieves labor time entries from the FieldEquip system.

The API returns a collection of time entry details with clock-in/clock-out information.

**Query Parameter Rules:**
The request can contain only one of these date combinations:
- `approvedDateFrom` and `approvedDateTo` — The range is inclusive, allowing a maximum of 3 days of data. The difference between these dates cannot exceed 2 days.
- `dateFrom` and `dateTo` — The range is inclusive, allowing a maximum of 3 days of data. The difference between these dates cannot exceed 2 days.
- `dateApproved` — Returns all approved records where the approvedDate equals the requested date, irrespective of the transactionDate.

**Note:** The deprecated endpoint `/api/v1/getTimeEntries` is also supported but this version (`/api/v2/labortime`) is recommended.

post.description:
Schedules one or more resources (technicians or equipment) to a work order.

The endpoint supports scheduling multiple resources in a single request. The resource details are provided as an array in the request body.

**Resource Type Rules:**
- `TECH` = Technician
- `EQPT` = Equipment

**Conditional Mandatory Fields:**
- `resourceId`: Mandatory when resourceType is `EQPT`. For `TECH`, this is the Employee ID. For `EQPT`, this is the Equipment ID.
- `emailId`: Mandatory when resourceType is `TECH`. Email address of the technician.

**Date/Time Format:**
- `schStartDate` / `schEndDate`: ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `schStartTime` / `schEndTime`: 24-hour format (HH:mm)

Adds one or more activity records to a work order.

The Activities API enables clients to add activity records including gauge measurements, quantities, and reference information.

**Date/Time Format:**
- `startDate` / `endDate`: ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `startTime` / `endTime`: 24-hour format (HH:MM)

**Gauge Measurements:**
- `topGaugeFt` / `topGaugeIn`: Top gauge measurement in feet and inches
- `bottomGaugeFt` / `bottomGaugeIn`: Bottom gauge measurement in feet and inches

post.description:
Updates the status of one or more Field Tickets.

This API is primarily used to synchronize Field Ticket status updates after successful export to an external ERP or accounting system.

**Business Rules:**
- The `fieldTicketIds` field accepts an array of Field Ticket IDs to update in a single request (e.g., ["5696", "5697", "5698"]).
- Currently the only supported status transition is to `40` (Invoiced).

**Field Ticket Status Values:**
- 40 = Invoiced

get.description:
Retrieves customer details from the FieldEquip system.

The filters will be considered as an "AND" condition while filtering the data. The API will return a collection of customers with all associated fields including billing address, contact information, and shipping details.

**Filtering Priority:**
- If `customerId` is provided, other filter parameters (`businessUnitCode`, `customerStatus`) will be ignored.

**Filter Parameters:**
- `customerId`: Unique customer ID (maxLength: 32)
- `businessUnitCode`: Business unit code (maxLength: 20)
- `customerStatus`: Active/Inactive (Default: Active)

post.description:
Creates a new user record in the FieldEquip system.

**Business Rules:**
- `userId` is mandatory and must be unique. If `businessUnitCode` is provided, `userId` must be unique within that Business Unit.
- `email` is optional. A user created without an email address will be created as a **Partial User** in the system.
- `roleId` is optional. FieldEquip will provide the Role ID if the customer wants to associate a default role to users.

get.description:
Retrieves transaction batch details from the FieldEquip system.

**Query Parameter Rules:**
- `batchDateFrom` and `batchDateTo`: Date range for filtering batches (e.g., 2023-08-21)
- `batchDateFrom`: Required when `batchNum` is not provided. The range between `batchDateFrom` and `batchDateTo` is inclusive with a maximum window of 3 days.
- `transactionType`: WO = Work Order. FT = Field Ticket. Filters batches by transaction type.
- `batchStatus`: Available values : COMPLETED, INVOICED.
- `batchNum` : Specific batch number to retrieve. When provided, all other parameters (`batchDateFrom`, `batchDateTo`, `businessUnit`, `batchStatus`) are ignored

BatchErrorCode.description:
Business logic error codes returned in failedRecords[].errorCode for batch operations,
or in errorCode for single-record failure responses.
| Code | When it occurs |
|------|----------------|
| DUPLICATE_RECORD | A record with the given ID already exists (Create operations) |
| RECORD_NOT_FOUND | The referenced record does not exist (Update / cross-reference operations) |
| INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION | The requested status change is not permitted from the current status |
| INSUFFICIENT_STOCK | A warehouse adjustment would result in negative stock |
| COMPANY_MISMATCH | The referenced record belongs to a different companyId |
| BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION | A business rule was violated — see message for details |
